prs.title: stash: export every note as a markdown file
prs.body:
Every note now exports as one markdown file into a folder you pick.

### The export writes one file per note

![Export](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/export.mp4)

prs.title: stash: export from the CLI into a folder you pick
prs.body:
`stash export <folder>` runs the export from the CLI and prints how many notes it wrote.

### The CLI prints the count

![CLI](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cli.png)
